script = '''
import pytesseract
from PIL import Image
import openpyxl

# Perform OCR on the invoice image
img = Image.open("uploads/invoice.png")
extracted_text = pytesseract.image_to_string(img)

print("=== EXTRACTED TEXT ===")
print(extracted_text)
print("=== END ===")

# Create Excel workbook
wb = openpyxl.Workbook()
ws = wb.active
ws.title = "Invoice OCR"

# Write header
ws["A1"] = "Extracted Invoice Text"
ws["A1"].font = openpyxl.styles.Font(bold=True, size=14)

# Write each line of extracted text into separate rows
lines = extracted_text.strip().split("\\n")
for i, line in enumerate(lines, start=2):
    ws.cell(row=i, column=1, value=line)

# Auto-adjust column width
max_len = max((len(str(line)) for line in lines), default=10)
ws.column_dimensions["A"].width = min(max_len + 2, 100)

wb.save("output/invoice_ocr.xlsx")
print("\\nExcel file saved to output/invoice_ocr.xlsx")
'''
await write_file("./ocr_script.py", script)
